blocks.text: LOS ANGELES, United States — An American soldier who sold what he claimed was top secret know-how to Chinese-linked buyers faces up to a decade in prison after admitting passing on sensitive military information. Army sergeant Jian Zhao, 37, took advantage of his security clearance to get his hands on restricted documents. He snapped pictures of military information on his mobile phone and offered to sell military computers and government hard drives, as well as details about communications networks, rocket and missile systems and military exercises. “By his own admission, Jian Zhao – a member of the US Armed Forces – betrayed […]...
